correctness.rationale: Any 6 disjoint covering layers require at least 6 transmitters for each of 367 targets. Radius at most 4 restricts those transmitters to 375 positions. Packing of colors j>=2 bounds counts by ceil(375/(j+1)); the maximum weighted count is 2201, contradicting required 2202. A period-30 certificate independently verifies the source upper construction, and its periodicity extends to all integer vertices. Finite computational verification is supplementary, not substituted for the unlimited proof.
